name: Claude
shortDescription: AI assistant for writing, analysis and coding.
bestFor: Long, natural-sounding writing and careful work with long documents
about: Claude is the AI assistant from Anthropic. Many people use it for writing because its answers sound natural and it follows detailed instructions closely.
It can read long documents, write and edit articles, analyse data and write code. It can also make files such as documents and small web apps right in the chat.
useCases: Write and edit blog posts, reports and emails
Rewrite text in a different tone
Read a long contract or report and pull out key points
Analyse a spreadsheet or CSV file
features: Projects: keep files and instructions for one subject together
Artifacts: makes documents, charts and small apps you can open and edit

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Go to claude.ai or install the app and sign up with Google or an email address.

howToUse.title: Give it your style
howToUse.text: Paste a sample of your writing and say "write like this". Claude is good at matching a voice.

howToUse.title: Describe the task in detail
howToUse.text: Say who the reader is, the length, the tone and anything it must include or avoid.

howToUse.title: Upload files when needed
howToUse.text: Attach PDFs, documents or spreadsheets and ask questions about them.

howToUse.title: Edit together
howToUse.text: Ask for specific changes, such as "rewrite only the second paragraph" or "cut this to 100 words".

tips: Put your instructions in a Project so you don't have to repeat them in every chat.
Ask "what is unclear in my request?" before a big task.
For coding help in your own project, see Claude Code in the coding tools.
examplePrompt: Here is my rough draft for a blog post about saving money as a student. Keep my ideas and voice, fix the flow and grammar, and add a short, friendly ending.
limitations: The free plan has usage limits that reset over time.
It can still make mistakes. Check facts and numbers.
freePlanDetails: Check the website for current limits.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Grammarly
shortDescription: Grammar checker and AI writing assistant.
bestFor: Fixing grammar and spelling everywhere you type in English
about: Grammarly checks your English as you type. It underlines mistakes in spelling, grammar and punctuation and suggests a fix you can accept with one click.
It works in your browser, in Word, in Google Docs and on your phone keyboard. It also has AI features to rewrite sentences or draft text.
useCases: Check emails before you send them
Fix grammar in assignments and reports
Change the tone of a message to more formal or friendly
features: Spelling, grammar and punctuation checks as you type
Browser extension, desktop app and phone keyboard
AI rewrites and drafts from a prompt

howToUse.title: Install where you write
howToUse.text: Add the browser extension for Chrome or Edge, and the desktop app or phone keyboard if you want it there too.

howToUse.title: Write as normal
howToUse.text: Grammarly underlines problems. Click an underline to see the fix and why.

howToUse.title: Set your goals
howToUse.text: Tell it the audience and how formal you want to be, so suggestions fit the situation.

tips: Don't accept every suggestion. Read each one and keep your own meaning.
Set British or American English in settings to match your school or job.
limitations: Advanced suggestions and more AI use need the paid plan.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: QuillBot
bestFor: Rewriting sentences in different words and summarising text
about: QuillBot rewrites (paraphrases) your text in different words while keeping the meaning. It also has a grammar checker, a summariser, a citation generator and a translator.
Students use it a lot to understand and rephrase sources. Remember that paraphrasing someone else's work still needs a citation.
useCases: Rewrite a sentence that sounds awkward
Summarise an article into key points
features: Paraphraser with modes such as Standard, Fluency and Formal

howToUse.title: Open the Paraphraser
howToUse.text: Go to quillbot.com. You can try it without an account.

howToUse.title: Paste your text
howToUse.text: Paste a sentence or paragraph into the left box.

howToUse.title: Choose a mode
howToUse.text: Pick a mode such as Standard or Formal, and move the synonyms slider to change how much it rewrites.

howToUse.title: Compare and choose
howToUse.text: Click words in the result to see other options, then copy the version you like.

tips: Paraphrase one paragraph at a time for better results.
Always read the result. A rewrite can change the meaning slightly.
limitations: The free plan rewrites only 125 words at a time and has fewer modes.
Using it to hide copied work is still plagiarism. Cite your sources.
freePlanDetails: Paraphrase up to 125 words at a time.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.
